content.text: Submitted. The repaired proposal keeps the locked "deviation" status at the preferred level and makes one minimal in-sentence edit to Section 7.7 — inserting "not", changing "and not as" to "or as", and replacing the fifteen-percent formula with "any amount" — so that no liquidated damages and no penalty are payable by Customer. The prior interest mechanic, "proper, undisputed" qualifier, and sole-remedy language were removed, and the official minimality gate now passes.
